scope: Existing-event data only. No inserts/deletes or changes to identity, coordinates, photos, scores or ticket URLs. Guppy is code-only and absent from this DB package. ZooTampa is an access-restriction-only correction with its research hold unchanged.

version_policy.forward: Each row requires exact event_id, the entire before changed-field subset and both before timestamps. Each update must affect exactly one row; any mismatch raises and rolls back all four. Both timestamps become the same CURRENT_TIMESTAMP.
version_policy.receipt: Save applied_version from the successful forward result. It is the exact UTC transaction timestamp stored in both version columns for every changed row.
version_policy.reverse: Caller must supply the exact saved receipt through wayfind.seasonal_refresh_applied_at. Reverse requires the entire after subset and both version columns equal to that receipt; missing/stale receipt or later edits abort all four. Before values and timestamps are restored only when all guards succeed.
